correctness.rationale: With A_i for maximality and D_ij for directed dominance, the incidence types (i=upper endpoint, i=lower endpoint impossible, and i disjoint) exhaust E(MQ). Conditional upper-orthant exclusion yields the U,V,W factorized integrals; the coefficient of 4^-d is n(n-1)[n(n-1)-(n-2)(n-3)]=n(n-1)(4n-6). The overlooked finite-order interactions would be O((5/24)^d); no uniform-in-n asymptotics is claimed. Independent exhaustive uniform coordinate-rank enumeration exactly reproduced the finite-sum covariances for six (n,d), and planar harmonic checks corroborated the specialization.

final_claim: For independent uniform [0,1]^d points with n>=3,d>=2, the Pareto maximum count M and comparable unordered pair count Q have the stated binomial-integral covariance, and for fixed n its first three large-d scales are -n(n-1)2^-d, -n(n-1)(n-2)3^-d, +n(n-1)(4n-6)4^-d, with O_n((5/24)^d) remainder.
limitations: Independent continuous uniform coordinates and product order only; n>=3,d>=2.
